as_told.title: Kirkpatrick's AARO advisory group and contract work with Oak Ridge

plain: When Sean Kirkpatrick left AARO, he went to work with Oak Ridge National Laboratory, a government research lab in Tennessee. AARO is the Pentagon office set up to investigate UAP, the official term for UFOs. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this in passing. He says Kirkpatrick "ran off to Oak Ridge" and urges listeners to look into the lab's links to FFRDCs, labs that are run privately but paid for by the government. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell, who speaks from his own involvement, gives more detail. He says the contract for an AARO advisory group was placed through Oak Ridge, and that since Kirkpatrick retired from government he has worked with and for Oak Ridge under contract. The tellers raise it because, if true, the man who ran the government's official UFO inquiry ended up at one of the very contractor networks that some say hold the secrets.
